description:
Project Overview

ICIQ invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within its Fully-Funded PhD Programme 2026 – Third Call. The project, "Single-Atom Skeletal Modification to Impact Drug Discovery and Chemical Biology" (reference PhD 2026-23 MG), is supervised by Dr. Marcos G. Suero.

The research focuses on developing methods for single-atom skeletal modification of organic molecules, enabling precise changes to molecular frameworks that can impact drug discovery and chemical biology research.

Research position overview

You will work on innovative synthetic methodology for editing molecular skeletons at the single-atom level, with applications in medicinal chemistry and chemical biology. The project combines synthetic organic chemistry, catalysis, and drug discovery.

Research Areas

  • Single-atom skeletal modification
  • Drug discovery and medicinal chemistry
  • Chemical biology
  • Synthetic methodology
  • Catalysis and reaction development
